name: The Thing Out There
ask: {what} is in {where}, and it has been there longer than the village.
We do not say its name. {what}. In {where}. Go and see.
Somebody has to go to {where}. You are the first one in years who might come back.
thanks: It is dead. I did not think I would hear that.
The valley sleeps tonight. Take this. Take all of it.
You did the thing nobody does.
